nodeReference: All fixture sources complete without throwing in an isolated Node vm context.
nativeValidation: Each case selected from a shared native image, launched in a fresh LLDB-controlled process, stopped at entry and verified to exit with status 42.
scope: Array every/some, find/findIndex/findLast/findLastIndex, reduce/reduceRight, indexOf/lastIndexOf/includes, splice/pop/shift/unshift. Covers holes, inherited properties, mutation, short-circuiting, coercion order, abrupt completion, callback receivers, species and partial writes. Not full Test262 coverage.
